description: This source file implements functions to retrieve network interface addresses on Android using netlink sockets, including setting interface names, flags, addresses, and prefixes, and managing memory for network interface structures.

classes.name: netlinkrequest
classes.description: Struct representing a netlink request with a header and message.

classes.name: FdTraits
classes.description: Traits for managing file descriptor lifetime.

classes.name: IfaddrsTraits
classes.description: Traits for managing ifaddrs pointer lifetime.

methods.name: set_ifname
methods.description: Sets the interface name in an ifaddrs structure based on interface index.

methods.name: set_flags
methods.description: Retrieves and sets interface flags using ioctl.

methods.name: set_addresses
methods.description: Sets the address in an ifaddrs structure based on family and data.

methods.name: make_prefixes
methods.description: Creates netmask prefixes for IPv4 or IPv6 addresses.

methods.name: populate_ifaddrs
methods.description: Populates an ifaddrs structure with interface information.

methods.name: Getifaddrs
methods.description: Retrieves network interface addresses on Android using netlink sockets.

methods.name: Freeifaddrs
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a linked list of ifaddrs structures.
